story.p1: As a Software Engineering student, I use modern technologies to build high-performance, scalable infrastructures and user-friendly applications. I don't limit my development process to writing code; I ground it in algorithm analysis and optimization principles. I place the highest priority on code quality, clean code architectures and sustainability.
story.p2: I complement my hands-on development experience in the React, TypeScript and Node.js ecosystems with the theoretical strength of computer science. Through the scientific and academic research I conduct on machine learning and large language models (LLMs), I strengthen my R&D vision.
story.p3: My greatest passion is combining technical depth with modern UI/UX design principles to create aesthetic, accessible solutions that meet high engineering standards. In everything I do, I carefully balance performance, user experience and aesthetics.
